title: antrophyum citrifolium
intro: Antrophyum citrifolium, commonly known as the lacy tree fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Antrophyum citrifolium include its use as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent, as well as its ability to aid in the relief of bronchitis and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
